description: This file defines the 'CustomField' class within the OpenCart admin model for customer-related custom fields. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving custom fields, their descriptions, values, and associated customer groups.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Represents the custom fields related to customers in the admin module, with methods to manage custom field data including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval of custom fields, descriptions, and associated customer groups.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field and its associated descriptions, customer groups, and values based on provided data.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field and manages its descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Removes a custom field and all related descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches multiple custom fields with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total number of custom fields.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a custom field in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for all custom fields in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for a specific custom field across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for custom fields in a specific language.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a customer group, including whether the field is required.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a specific custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Fetches the customer groups associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value option for a custom field, with handling for existing Value ID.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all value options associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field value by its ID.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Fetches all value options for a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a custom field value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific custom field value.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for custom field values in a specific language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for a specific custom field value across all languages.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for custom field values in a specific language.

search-terms: Opencart admin model customer custom field
